text.tspan: FNLLA / BRAND STANDARDS
EDITION 2.2.0 / 09
Composition & Backgrounds
One binary language, three levels: a campaign signature, a quiet field and a neutral information band.
fnlla.com
Created & maintained by TechAyo
techayo.co.uk
hello@techayo.co.uk
Lead Developer / Product Manager - Marcin Kordyaczny
01 / SIGNATURE
02 / FIELD
03 / BAND
Blue identifies.
Grey carries.
fnlla.com
Campaigns only. Not a new logo.
Decorative bytes. Not live data.
Reading first. Colour by role.
Let the work lead
Use an 8 px spacing rhythm with 4 px adjustments
for controls. Campaigns may use one large 01
silhouette made of Mono digits, away from the logo
and copy. It is not a second logo. Ordinary 01 / 02 /
03 labels can give workflow steps a readable
sequence. In tools, keep forms and data free of
decorative binary backgrounds.
The 01 campaign field
The bytes spell FNLLA in ASCII, not live data or AI
memory. Use grouped Mono octets, #DCE9FC on
white, with row breaks and fading edges. The blue 01
silhouette uses continuous digits and a faint
underlay for reduced-size legibility. Protect reading
areas, logo clear space and QR quiet zones. Do not
animate it.
Use real visual evidence
Use light-grey information bands for social headers
and repository art. Retain blue for marks, literal
addresses and small rules; print may use a strong
blue band. Diagrams explain actual boundaries, not
invented UI. Keep their key claims in adjacent
Markdown and descriptive alt text. Use neutral,
redacted screenshots.
